name: quality-workflow
description: Code-quality workflow: surface, triage, and resolve static-analysis findings (skylos for Python, fallow for TS/JS) with the same backlog-and-epic discipline that feature-workflow provides for feature work. Read-only quality-audit, structured quality-unblock that refuses bare suppressions, hook self-verification that asserts a known-bad fixture fails (catches the silently-misconfigured-hook class of bug). Sister plugin to feature-workflow.
